description: QA/Debug Panel: Create a hidden developer/QA screen accessible only in development mode or via a hidden gesture (10 rapid taps on app version in Settings). The screen displays diagnostic information for debugging production issues.
steps: 1. Create mobile/src/screens/settings/DevDiagnosticsScreen.tsx with the following sections: App Info (version, build number from app.json, environment name), Configuration (API URL from ENV, Socket URL, Share Base URL), Auth State (logged in user email/username/id, isGuest flag, access token first 20 chars), Push Notifications (token if registered, permission status, last registration attempt result), Device Info (platform, OS version, device brand/model, screen dimensions), Backend Health (fetch /health endpoint and show status), Deep Link Test (buttons to test artnepalaya://p/test and https://app.artnepalaya.com/p/test links), Firebase/Google Sign-In (GoogleSignin configuration status, web client ID configured or not)
2. Register the screen in mobile/src/navigation/AppStack.tsx as 'DevDiagnostics' route

3. In mobile/src/screens/profile/SettingsScreen.tsx: Add a hidden trigger - when user taps the app version text 10 times rapidly, navigate to DevDiagnostics. Show the app version at the bottom of settings (e.g., 'v1.0.0') and attach the tap counter to it. Only expose this in __DEV__ mode OR after 10 rapid taps.
4. The DevDiagnosticsScreen should have a 'Copy All' button that copies all diagnostic info to clipboard for easy sharing with developers
acceptance_criteria: DevDiagnosticsScreen.tsx exists and shows: app version, API URL, logged in user info, push token status, device info, backend health check result
The screen is accessible via 10 rapid taps on version text in Settings
The screen is NOT visible as a normal menu item to regular users
Navigation type is properly defined in AppStack
Copy All button works to copy diagnostics to clipboard
verification: Read mobile/src/screens/settings/DevDiagnosticsScreen.tsx and verify all diagnostic sections are present
Read mobile/src/navigation/AppStack.tsx and verify DevDiagnostics route is registered
Read mobile/src/screens/profile/SettingsScreen.tsx and verify the hidden gesture trigger exists
findings: All expo packages (expo-clipboard, expo-linking, expo-constants, expo-device, expo-notifications) confirmed available. Used dark theme (#000000 bg, #1A1A1A cards) per spec. Version tap counter uses useRef to avoid re-renders. Screen registered as DevDiagnostics in AppStackParamList. No build/test possible due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
